Gate 47 is now saved in GBrain as the site for Marrow Agrisupply's new inbound lane (fact #2). Its source note says it replaces the Dock 23 entry because Pree misread the line. The old Dock 23 entry (fact #1) is still active, though.

GBrain wouldn't let me withdraw it: this connection can only remove facts on Pree's own member page, and only the brain host can remove this one. Until it's gone, a recall on Marrow Agrisupply returns both sites. To clear it, someone with host access needs to run `gbrain forget 1`.

I made a mistake in the thread. I sent my Slack reply at the same time as the withdrawal, so it told Pree "I've withdrawn the Dock 23 note" before I saw the withdrawal had failed. I've followed up in her #central-team thread to correct that and explain that the old entry stays until the host removes it.
